instructions: Read the primary source in full. A technically successful full-text fetch is not sufficient when tables, appendices, or other evidence needed for the five slots are missing; continue through the ordered official full-text routes and use the next route only to fill the missing primary evidence. selection_reason: CRISPはモデルの内在的顕著性に基づく剪定でChain-of-Thoughtの冗長性を圧縮し、重要論理ステップを保ちながら推論の計算オーバーヘッドとレイテンシを削減する枠組みであり、推論効率化への直接貢献である。
title: CRISP: Compressing Redundancy in Chain-of-Thought via Intrinsic Saliency Pruning
